Load Center: Belize.
Feeder: 2.
Zone: 1 (portion).
Areas to be affected: the portion of downtown Belize City that includes Lancaster Street, York Street, and Castle Street.
Outage type: Scheduled.  
Purpose of outage: BEL to install utility pole and conduct upgrades in the area to improve the reliability of power supply to our Customers.
